## Task breakdown — `specs/001-bookmark-manager/tasks.md`

**72 tasks across 14 phases**, organized by your 11 user stories in priority order.

| Phase | Story | Tasks |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — Setup | infra/toolchain | T001–T007 |
| 2 — Foundational (blocks all) | DB schema, server, SPA shell | T008–T015 |
| 3 — **US1** Save w/ metadata (P1 🎯) | T016–T021 |
| 4 — **US2** Browse/search/sort (P1) | T022–T030 |
| 5 — US3 Tags + suggestions (P2) | T031–T035 |
| 6 — US4 Edit/delete, dup-opens-existing (P2) | T036–T040 |
| 7 — US5 Import/export (P2) | T041–T045 |
| 8 — US6 Read/unread ⟂ archive (P2) | T046–T049 |
| 9 — US7 Bulk actions (P2) | T050–T052 |
| 10 — US8 Saved views (P3) | T053–T055 |
| 11 — US9 Local + IA copies (P3) | T056–T059 |
| 12 — US10 Formatted notes (P3) | T060–T062 |
| 13 — US11 Display preferences (P3) | T063–T065 |
| 14 — Polish/validation | T066–T072 |

**Highlights**
- **MVP = US1 + US2** (save-with-metadata + browse/search/sort). You can stop and demo after Phase 4.
- **Tests included where they matter** (per the plan): unit tests for the search tokenizer/parser/evaluator, Netscape import/export round-trip, and metadata extraction; Playwright e2e for the P1 flows and the archive→restore-stays-unread path.
- **Your read/unread ⟂ archived correction is baked in**: the schema task (T009) creates independent `is_read`/`is_archived` columns; T046 unit-tests the derived views and independence; T047 enforces that setting one flag never changes the other.
- **Data-model constraints are quoted verbatim** in tasks (unique `url`, enum values for sort/density/text-size, capture/snapshot status enums) so they aren't left to implementation-time guesswork.
- **Parallel opportunities** and an MVP-first / incremental delivery strategy are documented.

**Optional before implementing:** I can run `speckit-analyze` (a non-destructive consistency check across spec/plan/tasks) if you'd like an extra verification pass. Otherwise—

This is the final gate before building. If the breakdown looks right, say **approved** (and whether you want the **full build** or just the **US1+US2 MVP** first) and I'll begin `speckit-implement`. If you'd like to adjust scope, ordering, or any task, I'll revise `tasks.md` first.
